svg.title: Ongoing / Ongoing as a software inventory
svg.desc: The whole redesign in one frame. Phases 1 through 5 have landed: entries, the field registry, the query grammar, the entries API, the CLI and its transport, the keyboard-first browser shell that builds the same query string, the provider manifests, one configuration file, the host adapter, and the deployment and export profiles. Phase 6 — completeness, remote-only entries, and the open-source release — is not modelled yet.. Architecture structure.
